intended_object: The oplax functor LocallyDiscrete C → LocallyDiscrete D induced by an ordinary functor F : C ⥤ D, as stated in the docstring.
explanation: The definition is F.toPseudofunctor.toOplax, which is exactly what the docstring describes. A functor induces a pseudofunctor between locally discrete bicategories, whose only 2-morphisms are identities, so all structure maps are forced. Forgetting that pseudofunctor to an oplax functor gives the canonical lift. C and D are arbitrary categories, so the definition is at full generality.
